name: Mergeware
source:
> ERROR 404: Memories not found. Reboot needed....

> Starting new life...

When you wake up in another world with no memories in a body you don't recognize at all, things are already appearing pretty bad for you. With your only memories being that you were once human and that you may or may not have met an untimely demise, you meet new allies to help you fight back against the evil .Exe menace! Unfortunately, you appear to be one as well, but at least you are a friendly one! With the power to fuse with your allies and boost your powers by becoming one, you just might stand a chance! Now to actually convince people into letting you take over and transform their body...

[From [url=https://slushyanimals.itch.io/mergeware]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
> 错误404：未找到内存。需要重启….

> 开始新的生活…

当你在另一个世界醒来时，你的身体里没有任何记忆，你根本不认识，事情对你来说已经很糟糕了。你唯一的记忆是你曾经是人类，你可能会或可能不会过早死亡，你会遇到新的盟友来帮助你对抗邪恶的威胁！不幸的是，你似乎也是其中之一，但至少你是一个友好的人！凭借与盟友融合并通过成为盟友来增强自己力量的能力，你可能会有机会！现在要真正说服人们让你接管并改造他们的身体……
